title: Trump Accounts launch July 4: NYSE & Nasdaq ring Oval Office opening bell on July 6 as 6M+ families enroll
summary: The U.S. Treasury's 'Trump Accounts' officially launched on July 4, 2026 — government-backed children's investment accounts seeded with a one-time $1,000 federal deposit for children born Jan 1, 2025 – Dec 31, 2028. Families can contribute up to $5,000/year; all funds auto-invested in State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPYM, 2 bp expense ratio). On July 6, NYSE and Nasdaq CEOs rang the opening bell from the Oval Office alongside President Trump. Over 6 million families enrolled as of Thursday.
why: Trump Accounts在制度层面将6百万以上家庭与美股S&P 500指数深度绑定，预计形成长期持续的被动资金流入（类似401K效应），利好大盘和持仓的所有美股标的；开盘钟从白宫敲响，是本届政府强化资本市场与政治叙事绑定的明确信号。

title: 阿里巴巴FY2026末期股息今日（7月6日）派付：每股0.13125美元，无需预扣税
summary: 阿里巴巴集团（9988.HK / BABA）今日向普通股股东支付FY2026末期股息，每普通股0.13125美元（每ADS约1.05美元），无需扣缴税款。登记日为2026年6月11日，除息日为6月10日。ADS持有人预计于7月13日前后收到分红。本次为公司自2014年上市以来历史上第二次派发末期股息，FY2026年度股息总计约34亿美元。
why: 阿里巴巴加强回报股东力度，末期股息+历史性分红规模对长期持有者是积极信号；ADS持有者行权价选择需注意7月6-13日分红支付窗口的除息效应。
source: SEC Form 6-K (Alibaba Group Holding Ltd, May 2026) / TipRanks

title: Walmart (WMT) -8.6% to 8-month low as Cleveland Research flags slowing US comps and inventory discounting
summary: Walmart stock fell 8.6% to an eight-month low after Cleveland Research issued a negative note flagging decelerating U.S. comparable-store sales and warning the retailer may need to cut prices to clear excess inventory — compounding tariff headwinds and higher oil costs. The report cited slightly less positive management tone on the macro/consumer outlook. WMT has pulled back further since, trading near $111 as of July 5.
why: 沃尔玛（持仓标的）出现首次重大负面研报事件：可比销售减速+库存去化压价，对FY2026 Q2利润率构成明确下行压力；这与Target等同行低迷形成共振；sell put需注意行权价需在当前支撑位（~$107）下方设置足够安全垫，并警惕7月下旬财报前的波动率高企。
source: Yahoo Finance / CNBC (Cleveland Research, late June 2026)

title: Kioxia & SanDisk begin production of 10th-gen 3D flash memory at Kitakami Plant Fab2 (K2)
summary: Kioxia Corporation and SanDisk Corporation announced on July 2, 2026 the start of production of 10th-generation 3D flash memory products at Fab2 (K2) of the Kitakami Plant in Japan. The facility opened in September 2025; Fab2 now ramps alongside 8th-gen to meet surging AI data center and consumer storage demand. The advanced BiCS FLASH architecture uses earthquake-resistant construction and AI-driven manufacturing for higher yield and energy efficiency. Both companies have long-term supply agreements in place.
why: 闪迪(SNDK)官方发布是本轮NAND超级周期产能的里程碑确认，10代BiCS量产意味着BOM成本继续下行、良率提升，直接支撑闪迪FY2026-27超高毛利率叙事；与Bernstein $3000目标价、LTA合同锁定结构一道，共同夯实了闪迪sell put策略的基本面锚；Kioxia同期量产也验证整体NAND行业投入加速，美光亦受益。
source: BusinessWire (official press release) / Yahoo Finance Tech
